messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "safely throw away medicine that is out of date or no longer needed"
set: ["safely throw away medicine that is out of date or no longer needed", "no dose reduction is needed", "discontinued and no longer available", "selling or giving away this medicine is against the law", "throw away if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "dose is adjusted at intervals of a week or longer", "dose is higher than needed", "get prescription refilled before running out of medicine completely", "keep out of light", "do not sell or give away medicine", "throw away unused suspension 30 days after made up", "use mixed medicine right away", "increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "after medicine is stopped", "selling or giving away is against the law", "24 hours or longer"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
